notes.title: Bugs Fixed
notes.content:
This update fixes bugs and prepares the game for cross-platform play, will be unlocked in the next update.

The icons in the map are enlarged for better viewing.
Totem, causing blocking of construction has been fixed.
Fixed "The End" quest for PS5.
The lighting radius of torches has been increased.
You can now control the Weather and UI sounds.
Added a new climbing system.
Fixed falling under the terrain, that was sometimes happening to some people.
Optimizations have been made....

The game is being prepared for Cross-Platform Play, Co-Op, Multiplayer, will be enabled in the next update.

notes.title: Bugs Fixed
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs.
Added option to "Totem" to skip the night.
Added more game save slots.
Added compass icon for "Mine Iron" for easier finding.
Fixed a bug, causing an item to disappear when trying to add it to the hotbar.
Added a hint to some Quests for easier navigation.
...

notes.title: Bugs fixed
notes.content:
Some bugs have been fixed.
The climate system has been edited, increased time to change seasons, the rainy season has been edited to not rain as often.
The night is shorter.
Fixed invert X/Y Axis controls.
Added markers to the flowers, stones,...
Quest Training now starts automatically when starting a game.
Added information to help with where the fibers are collected (from flowers).
Meat spoilage time is increased.
Compass directions relative to the map are fixed.
Increased the chance of getting coconuts from trees.
Fixed merchant cloning.
Fixed totem issue.
Fixed Water Storage.
For consoles added option to control menu in inventory via Xbox LB/RB and L1/R1 buttons for ps5.
And more...

Patches have been sent to all platforms PC/Xbox Series, PS5.

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
The entire game has been redesigned and updated.
The game is also released for Xbox Series, PS5, Windows Store.
